facts.fact: Burundi's National Assembly adopted the law on the protection of personal data on 15 January 2026 and the head of state promulgated it on 10 March 2026, per Community Voice; the article does not state a commencement date.
The law establishes an independent administrative authority to oversee data protection; the article does not say the authority has been constituted. Law promulgated 10 March 2026.
